issues.description: The template's private helper method singFarmSongVerse is declared without an Animal parameter (the parameter is commented out), while the problem UML and the reference solution define singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal). This mismatch in the method signature between template and solution/problem statement can confuse students about the intended helper API and may lead to compilation/design confusion when they try to follow the UML and solution approach.
issues.suggestedFix: Adjust the template Farm.java so the private helper matches the UML and solution: change the method signature to private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) and update the method body to use the passed-in animal. This keeps the template consistent with the problem specification and the reference implementation.
